title: Is minimum-weight triangulation in NP?
formal: Given a finite planar point set with rational coordinates and a rational bound B, is deciding whether it admits a triangulation of total Euclidean edge length at most B in NP?
context:
NP-hardness is already known. Polynomial-time solution is not the unresolved classification claimed here; the numerical comparison issue is related to sums of square roots.

This question was found through Wikipedia and compared individually with the existing candidate and archived records. The linked literature provides definitions and background; this import is not a completed research-card review.
why: Asks whether exact geometric optimization has short certificates despite the algebraic cost of verifying lengths.
